AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Selected Crop Management Practises? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Selected Crop Management Practises.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Selected Crop Management Practises.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Selected Crop Management Practises.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Selected Crop Management Practises.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production .

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products 9 2.4 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene in Rearing Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene in Rearing Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene in Rearing Animals.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Food Nutrients? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Food Nutrients.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Food Nutrients.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Food Nutrients.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Food Nutrients.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparing Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparing Animal Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparing Animal Products.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparing Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparing Animal Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals 9 3.2 Laundry: Loose-coloured Items 8 4.0 Production  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene in Rearing Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
